scope_note: All retained analytics results filter canonical production hosts only. Unfiltered discovery counts appear solely as a clearly labeled measurement-contamination finding in the HTML report.

queries.corrected_lcp: SELECT replaceRegexpOne(replaceRegexpOne(toString(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_event.navigationURL),'^https?://[^/]+',''),'[?#].*$','') AS measured_path, properties.$device_type AS device, count() AS n, uniq(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_event.id) AS metric_ids, quantile(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value)) AS p75_ms, quantile(0.5)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value)) AS p50_ms FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now()-INTERVAL 7 DAY AND event='$web_vitals' AND properties.$host IN ('proplane.ai','www.proplane.ai') AND properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL AND properties.$web_vitals_LCP_event.navigationURL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY measured_path,device ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25
queries.sign_in_browser: SELECT properties.$browser AS browser, properties.$os AS os, properties.$device_type AS device, count() AS n, quantile(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value)) AS p75_ms, countIf(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value)>8000) AS above8s FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now()-INTERVAL 7 DAY AND event='$web_vitals' AND properties.$host='proplane.ai' AND properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL AND properties.$web_vitals_LCP_event.navigationURL LIKE 'https://proplane.ai/auth/sign-in%' GROUP BY browser,os,device ORDER BY n DESC
